issue_context.title: Option Vega Indicator
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
Vega, as the measure of option price change relative to 1% change in the implied volatility of the underlying, is available readily as an indicator for securities with type `SeucrityType.Option`.

#### Actual Behavior
There is no indicator for Vega, the only source is option chain object calculated from QuantLib.

#### Potential Solution
Implement an indicator for Vega.

#### Reproducing the Problem
Relay from #7611

#### System Information
NA
